text: of the Mizoram Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (6 of 2017) read with sub-rule (5) of rule 61 of the Mizoram Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017, the Governor of Mizoram, on the recommendations of the Council, hereby makes the following further amendments- (i) in notification No.J.21011/1/2017-TAX/Vol-I/Pt, dated the 3rd October, 2017, and (ii) in notification No. 16/2018 - State Tax, dated the 2nd May, 2018 01-07-2020 “Explanation - For the purposes of this entry, the term “bus body building” shall include building of body on chassis of any vehicle falling under chapter 87 in the First Schedule to the Customs Tariff Act, 1975.” Vanlal Close × Act NameThe Mizoram Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017Orders" YearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi)21-01-2019 NOTIFICATION No. 62/2018-State Tax No. J. 21011/2/2018(ll)-TAX, the 18th January, 2019.
